evidenceNotes: Pinned BWAPI4.4.0/OpenBW extractor reproduces Queen100/100,313economic ticks,120HP,2supply,air and no weapon/detection; Nest150/100,375ticks requires completed Lair and creep; Ensnare100/100 research500ticks,75energy,288px range; Gamete150/150,1042ticks,max250/new62.5 without a refill. Existing production cancellation remains full refund with consumed larva and queue abstraction.

Ensnare is an immediate point cast against hitboxes intersecting a64px half-width square; no damage, excludes caster,buildings,burrowed,cargo and Stasis. Authored policy rejects out-of-range without approach and uses18tick cooldown; no original projectile flight,animation windup or spell autocast.

Original additive modifiers: Stim+1,Ensnare-1; negative means floor(speed/2), weapon interval plus floor(interval/4), clamped5..250frames. Together they restore base movement/weapon interval without overwriting base speed,existing attack deadlines or victim orders. Duration75cycles*8frames=500ticks, refreshes without stacking and elapses through cargo/Stasis and source death. Drone cancellation retains status; building completion clears it.

Ensnare reveals permanent/personal/Arbiter cloak only inside existing shared sight, does not grant fog visibility, remove cloak or stop cloak drain. Restoration removes blindness and Ensnare together for its existing50energy and retains HP,Stim,cloak and Stasis. Render effects omit entity references and enemy cast cooldowns remain private.

618 game tests, including22 Queen/status tests, pass. The initial full run had3 stale expectations:53 definitions instead of55 and old Zerg practice gas. These were updated to the explicitly labelled new units/resources. Focused25 pass and the entire final npm test passes with frozen source. Shared258,Haeru50,Baksal28 pass; canonical fresh-install CI repeats all checks,lab and benchmark.

Both portrait sizes locally and on production use actual Worker/Pixi/native touch, pay500tick Ensnare/1042tick Gamete research, naturally regenerate from50 to75energy, cast on friendly ground/air units with no damage, roundtrip exact active status/cooldown/energy/orders/RNG, wait full500tick expiry and pay313tick larva production for a third upgraded Queen. No resource/state injection.

Eighteen untouched production saves from formats12..21 restore locally and on production at exact ticks. Active blindness/cast cooldown,Stim,Medic jobs,energy upgrades,cargo,cloak,siege,morphs,pending spells,groups,resources and RNG are retained. Original raw bytes are backed up. Migration grants no Queen,Nest,research,energy or resources.

Production also repeats Medic Optical/Restoration,Stim plus Medic recovery,and manual Recall/Stasis including full873tick thaw and resumed movement. Actual source feature runtime and UI are tested against the final deployed build.

All206 deployment files SHA256-match a clean canonical build. Lossless concatenated gzip members fit32MiB without asset modification. GitHub main,Sites source push,saved version,native terminal deployment and public12-character buildId match the recorded commit. Source and QA ZIPs are CRC checked and SHA256 hashed.

The first production browser launch hit workspace ENOSPC before any interaction. Generated tar/build outputs were moved to the separate temporary volume and original paths retained as symlinks; source,game saves and ZIP backups were preserved. Both production test launches were restarted.

An automation queue initially referenced the previous checkout, causing stale-format test expectations to fail. The queue and evidence helper now use the Queen checkout; final reports are from that exact source. Earlier automation outputs are kept under initial-wrong-harness directories and do not contribute to the passing case count.

Chromium SwiftShader/native touch does not certify physical Android/iOS devices or hardware GPU performance. Portrait-only behavior is preserved. Queen Parasite,Broodlings,Infest and spell autocast,final graphics and strategic AI are later work.
